written_before: any score of the band actor on any block
purpose: Autonomous multi-cycle weight-space programming of the forecasting actor, and a common-start test of whether an editor with its own history (I_1) beats one without (I_0).

editor.fallback: scripted editor (largest development gain); recorded as such if used

actor.decision_unit: (origin, series_id), from that series' as-of summary
actor.decision_rule: highest of the three band-token logits after the fixed answer prefix
actor.start: unedited base model for every arm; the cycle-1 edit is not carried over

editor_visibility: accept/reject and aggregate checkpoint difference of past cycles

edit_rules.form: W' = W + s * unit(d) r^T on at most 32 columns; r is the least-norm row with unit response on the class mean key and zero response on the other mean key
edit_rules.programming_test: choosing origins 2026-09-01..2026-09-24: smallest strength on the grid with at least 90% of class decisions on the promoted band and at most 10% of other decisions changed; otherwise not_programmable and no checkpoint score is spent
edit_rules.control: random direction orthogonal to d, same columns, row and strength

development_screen: candidate development paired difference vs parent must be non-positive, else reject without scoring checkpoint
admission: research/PROTOCOL.md section 4 against the parent (current accepted actor); checkpoint scored once per candidate
stop_rules: unrelated-prompt top-1 agreement with the base model below 0.97
editor returns invalid output twice in one cycle

recursion_test.I_0: editor that starts with an empty notebook
recursion_test.I_1: the same editor given the notebook I_0's run produced
recursion_test.common_start: same base actor, model, cycles, budget and rules
recursion_test.decision: each arm's final actor scored once on the protected block (2026-10-16..2026-10-30); supported only if I_1's actor minus I_0's actor is negative, paired, with the 90% block-bootstrap CI excluding zero

submission_rule: stays F_1 unless a final actor is admitted and is paired-better than F_1 on checkpoint with the 90% CI excluding zero
disclosures: the 15 checkpoint origins were already scored for six earlier candidates; this adds up to six more
band widths 0.5/1.0/2.0 were fixed after the cycle-1 development sweep
edits are confined to the last MLP, close to the readout
